searchText: I’ve been rereading the EIP to familiarize myself and there are two things I’m unclear about wrt the security assumptions of the PTC: 1. Does this hold after removing MaxEB? The entire point of MaxEB was that you generally want equal stake for committees. 2. Using a hypergeometric distribution calculator, I can’t arrive at the number in the EIP: 35% of malicious stake can’t control the PTC. I think you would need 75% honest nodes to always have 67% in the PTC, using PTC size of 512. Am I missing something? The threshold we're using is 50%, I don't understand the first question about maxEB <@688748669268132001> regarding https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4453 why would trustless payment be a bottleneck for scaling? I don't see how this impacts scaling. Whether it's scaling of blobs, block size etc. maybe you are referring to some other scaling?

excerpts.author: sophia_24798
excerpts.content:
I’ve been rereading the EIP to familiarize myself and there are two things I’m unclear about wrt the security assumptions of the PTC:

1. Does this hold after removing MaxEB? The entire point of MaxEB was that you generally want equal stake for committees. 

2. Using a hypergeometric distribution calculator, I can’t arrive at the number in the EIP: 35% of malicious stake can’t control the PTC. I think you would need 75% honest nodes to always have 67% in the PTC, using PTC size of 512. 

Am I missing something?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: The threshold we're using is 50%, I don't understand the first question about maxEB
